nodes.text: few exceptions of phylogenetic might suggest past recombination events, detected possible recombination breakpoints in F, SH, G coding regions. 5 genetic lineages of HMPVs shared quite remote common ancestors ranging more than 220 to 470 years of age with most recent origins for A2b sublineage. Purifying selection was common, but most protein genes except the F and M2-2 coding regions also appeared to experience episodic diversifying selection.
